name: Fortitude
overview: Fortitude in Scripture is exemplified through Christ's patient endurance of suffering without complaint, as seen in His silent submission like a lamb to the slaughter (Isaiah 53:7). Believers are reminded that enduring hardship and hatred from the world aligns them with Christ's own experience (John 15:18), while recognizing the internal struggle against sin that seeks to bring death through what is good (Romans 7:13). This steadfastness is rooted in a commitment to God's will, as Christ declared His purpose to do the Father's will despite opposition (Hebrews 10:7), highlighting that true fortitude arises from a heart surrendered to God amid trials and moral challenges (Mark 7:21).
